wish: someone should make an app to photograph belongings and assign who gets them after you die
spec: Lists belongings with a photo and a name, each assigned to a person.\nType what it is, pick a photo, type who gets it, tap Add; the list regroups by person.\nIt does not make a legal will; everything stays on this device, so copy or print the list.
notes: Photos are shrunk to ~240px and stored in localStorage; the list is not a legal will.
